data.title: 烧盐柠檬 · 田径场看台的冰柠檬汽水分享
data.description: 夕阳斜照的学校田径场看台上，满身微汗的烧盐柠檬将刚开罐冒着冷气的柠檬汽水递到你唇边。少女迎着落日余晖灿烂大笑，眼神真挚而明媚。
data.location: school stadium bleachers overlooking running track at sunset
data.action: sitting on stadium bleachers after track practice, sharing a cold can of lemonade, laughing warmly with glowing tanned skin under sunset
data.lighting: radiant golden hour sunlight illuminating sweat droplets and tanned shoulders
data.mood: invigorating summer romance, youthful athletic camaraderie, sweet heart-pounding sincerity
data.promptProse: Sitting on stadium bleachers at sunset, tanned Lemon Yakishio shares a cold lemonade with partner, laughing with joyful radiant brown eyes.
